Inventory Entry Point Catalogue

EP-RCV-01 ReceiveGoods proposed Received command

route: POST /api/inventory/receive

input: sku, qty, warehouse_id; schema ReceiveGoods.json

guards: warehouse exists

  1. Code validate payload schema
  2. Code persist receipt

outputs: GoodsReceived

errors: UnknownWarehouse

idempotency: key on sku + receipt_id

Given a warehouse When goods received Then on_hand increases

EP-RSV-01 ReserveStock Available -> Reserved command

route: POST /api/inventory/{sku}/reserve

input: sku, qty, order_id

guards: on_hand >= qty

  1. Code check availability
  2. AI decides allocate across warehouses
  3. AI suggests substitute SKUs
  4. Code decrement available

outputs: StockReserved

errors: InsufficientStock

idempotency: key on order_id

Given available stock When reserved Then reserved increases

EP-QRY-01 GetAvailability query

route: GET /api/inventory/{sku}/availability

outputs: AvailabilityReport

  1. Code read projection
